prose: Documentation for Antigravity's /swarm: a team of named agents splits your task, works in parallel and coordinates on a shared message board, with a verifier agent reviewing changes. Your conversation becomes the coordinator; the board and graph views show workers' progress. Suggested when a task divides cleanly across files or questions.
highlights: Named agents split tasks and coordinate on a board
A verifier reviews before you see changes
Works in the Antigravity app and CLI
